title: One fact: one line of data/facts/<service>.jsonl
description: The fact canon. Only saalib/facts.py writes these files. Cross-field rules (the mechanical checks M1 to M12 in TOOLS.md) are checked by `facts verify`, not here.

service.description: fact namespace: a service key of the registry, or a key of book.fact_namespaces

claim.description: one or two sentences in the book's own words; every number in it appears in a quote

question.description: the question this fact answers; the only thing a re-derivation verifier sees; required (M13) when hard is true

scope.description: for example 'per NAT gateway', 'per Region, per account'

derivation.description: how a value that is not literal in a quote was derived; needs a 'derive' vote

tier0.description: a fact that decides many answers; always part of audit samples

was.description: the old value, verbatim from the evidence

was_evidence.description: index into evidence of the quote that states the old value

change_items.description: ids of change-feed items that touch this fact

votes.description: summary written by `facts finalize`; the vote log is the source

retrieved.description: date the evidence was last checked against the snapshot

author.description: label of the agent that added the fact; that label cannot vote on it

amended_by.description: labels of the agents that changed the fact with `facts amend --by`; none of them can vote on it

supersedes.description: set on the new fact by `facts amend OLD --supersede NEW`

stale.description: why the fact went back to candidate, for example 'quote-missing' or 'snapshot-changed'

mech.description: last result of the mechanical checks; written by `facts add`, `adopt`, `amend`, and by `facts verify` only when the status changes

display.description: a canonical value string; link text must contain one of these

spoken.description: the value written for speech, without digits

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the snapshot .txt at the time of the last check

match.description: start and end in the normalised page text

table_header.description: header row, verbatim, when the quote is a table row

heading.description: heading text, when the quote is one whole value line under that heading (M4 heading-scoped quote, TOOLS.md 5.2); absent or null otherwise
